title: Remove 60s hook_status staleness window
description: agent_state() only trusts hook_status if <60s old. State only changes on hook events, so absence of events = unchanged state. Make last hook verdict authoritative until next event.
close_reason: agent_state(): removed 60s hook_status freshness gate; last hook verdict authoritative until next event. Build clean, 230 tests pass.

title: Self-healing cmux event subscriber (respawn + reap orphans)
description: subscribe() is fire-and-forget; if the cmux events child dies, mc silently loses hook updates until restart. Wrap in respawn loop with capped backoff. Reap orphaned subscribers on startup + kill_on_drop (DONE in events.rs).
close_reason: events.rs: reap orphans (pkill -f) before spawn + kill_on_drop(true); main.rs respawn loop w/ capped backoff. Cleared 9 live orphans. Build clean.

title: Hooks-first agent state: local→hooks, remote→typesafe
description: Transition local-agent state detection to cmux hook events as the authoritative signal; keep typesafe scoped to remote (ssh/mosh) agents that have no hook bridge. Sub-work: (1) self-healing event subscriber, (2) remove the 60s staleness window so the last hook verdict persists until the next event, (3) scope typesafe classification to remote workspaces + remove dead file-based hook path. Also reaped orphan cmux-events subscribers (kill_on_drop + startup pkill).
notes: cz5+01c done. Remaining: l7h (scope typesafe to remote-only + drop dead file-based hook path) — pending design confirmation on where remote/local is decided in the classify path.
close_reason: Hooks-first transition complete: local agents → durable hook_status (no staleness), remote agents → typesafe (gated to remote-only), self-healing subscriber + orphan reaping. Restart mc to run the new release binary.

title: Remote-surface intent via screen-grab + frame merge
description: Remote (mosh/ssh→labs) agent surfaces have no cmux event bridge, so show no overall/latest. Approach: detect mosh/ssh surfaces, screen-grab every 5s, merge overlapping captures (anchor-vote scroll delta + learned volatile masking), change-gated LLM infer {overall, latest_ask} with strict 'submitted vs suggested' guardrails, cache to ~/data/mission-control. Phase 1 (this issue): validated frame-merge core (src/mc_data/frame_merge.rs) with real labs frames as fixtures. Validated on live surface:29: anchors 100+ agree, idle→0 new, scrolls→correct deltas (0,18,35,4,4). Remaining phases in docs/plans/remote-surface-intent.md: detection, grab loop, trailing-status peel refinement, LLM layer, cache, identity.
notes: Phase 3 landed + verified live: xai::infer_intent extracts {overall, latest_ask} from the merged remote transcript (guardrails against suggestions/placeholders), change-gated (+8 lines), cached in RemoteWatch, rendered via the projection for Remote surfaces. Live on surface:30/labt: overall+latest both populated in the TUI. Commits a265f41 + plan. Remaining: optional token-level mask + deep first-grab (phase 4).

title: mc fights blueprint histories layout: histories must live in ~/agents (Obsidian vault), not ~/data/Sessions
description:
TUI fails to load session data with: 'histories dir validation failed: ~/agents/histories points to .../Obsidian/Agents/Sessions, expected ~/data/Sessions'.

Root cause: mc hardcodes ~/data/Sessions as the canonical session-log store and even migrates the blueprint symlink away from the vault, contradicting the agents blueprint where ~/agents/histories -> obs/Agents/Sessions is canonical (541 real logs there vs 1 in ~/data/Sessions). Secondary bug: prompts::obsagents_root() and summarize::output_dir() fall back to a nonexistent ~/agents/Obsidian symlink instead of the real ~/agents/obsAgents.

Decision (Boyan): align mc to blueprint. Relax validate_histories_dir to dir+readable; stop setup.rs creating ~/data/Sessions and migrating the histories symlink; remove session_logs_dir; fix obsagents_root/output_dir fallbacks to ~/agents/obsAgents; update smoke tests. Release build + verify.
close_reason: Aligned mc to the agents blueprint. validate_histories_dir now just checks dir+readable (trusts the blueprint symlink); setup.rs no longer creates ~/data/Sessions or repoints ~/agents/histories (warns if missing); removed paths::session_logs_dir; fixed obsagents_root()/summarize::output_dir() fallbacks from nonexistent ~/agents/Obsidian to ~/agents/obsAgents. Updated 4 smoke tests (2 setup, 1 inverted migrate->preserve, 1 inverted backfill fail->accept). Verified: release backfill-window succeeds against the real vault-backed ~/agents/histories (5 workspaces/17 surfaces); setup leaves the blueprint symlink untouched. 224 bin + 11 smoke tests pass single-threaded (1 pre-existing parallel-race test unrelated).

title: Window-scoped repo and surface registry
description: Mission Control should model the active cmux window explicitly: detect repos used by each workspace/surface, aggregate Beads from one or more repos, use ~/agents/histories for session logs, and persist a human-readable window registry under ~/data/mission-control/windows/<window-id>/ with workspace/surface JSON records.
acceptance_criteria: Refresh detects repo roots from workspace cwd and surface activity; single-repo workspaces show that repo's Beads; multi-repo workspaces aggregate Beads ordered by highlighted/current surface repo; session/history lookup uses and validates ~/agents/histories; registry schema is persisted under ~/data/mission-control/windows/<window-id>/ with clear workspace/surface JSON; tests and cargo build --release pass.
close_reason: Implemented window-scoped registry/backfill, histories validation/migration, multi-repo Beads ordering, bottom info IDs, and validated via tests/build/live cmux window.

title: Show Beads and conversation intent in workspace details
description: Update mission-control so workspace detail pages reflect the repo-wide Beads workflow and better summarize what each agent surface is doing. Replace or supersede the existing goals/progress section with a Beads-focused view where feasible, and make each surface bullet show both the overall conversation goal and the latest user ask summary. Use authoritative cmux/session/hook/event state where available.
acceptance_criteria: Detail view includes a Beads section sourced from repo-local bd data or tracked exports; goals/progress content is replaced or subordinated by Beads where requested; each surface row/bullet shows an overall goal line and a latest ask summary line; implementation is covered by focused tests and cargo build --release passes.
close_reason: Implemented Beads detail projection and per-surface conversation intent summaries; cargo test, release build, CLI smoke, and PTY TUI smoke passed.

title: Reap orphan cmux events subscribers on mc restart
description: A SIGKILLed/crashed mc leaves its long-lived 'cmux events --reconnect --category agent --no-heartbeat' child orphaned (reparented to launchd); each restart stacked another. Reap by exact-argv pkill -f before spawning, and kill_on_drop(true) so graceful shutdown takes the child with it.
close_reason: Implemented in src/cmux/events.rs: EVENTS_ARGS shared slice, reap_orphan_subscribers() via pkill -f exact argv before spawn, kill_on_drop(true) on the child. Release build passes.

title: Consume centralized mux protocol state (~/data/mux) instead of dedicated agent hooks
description: Boyan directive (2026-06-09): agents' native hooks feed ONE centralized PROTOCOL store — ~/data/mux/sessions/<session_id>.json (working flag, last_event, turn_count, prompt/turn timestamps; locked single-writer 'arcmux hook') plus per-session JSONL under ~/data/mux/hook-output/. The dir is deliberately protocol-named (mux), not app-named: arcmux is today's producer but the contract is the files. Contract doc: ~/Projects/arcmux/docs/state-dir.md (~/data/arcmux/ is arcmux-private and NOT part of the contract). mission-control should read ~/data/mux for agent-activity facts (working/idle, last turn end, turn counts) instead of registering its own claude/codex hooks where the data overlaps. Scope: (1) inventory what mission-control-hook.sh collects (workspace_id ↔ session-file stamping) vs what mux state provides; (2) consume mux state for overlapping facts; (3) keep a hook ONLY for non-overlapping facts, or extend the mux session env/state to carry them and drop the hook entirely. Same migration applies to cmux.app's hook bridges (separate effort, no checkout here).
acceptance_criteria: mission-control derives agent working/idle + turn timing from ~/data/mux/sessions/*.json (poll or fswatch); any retained hook is justified in a comment as non-overlapping; net hook count for mission-control purposes decreases; verified against a live mux-spawned claude and grok session.
close_reason: Shipped mux-state reader for ~/data/mux/sessions JSON, wired WorkspaceState mux_status polling via cmux session_id->workspace_id mapping, removed hook-event/session-frontmatter status derivation, documented retained mc bind/session-history hook as non-overlapping, and added fixture tests for claude/grok-style mux state because no current live mux-spawned claude/grok session docs were running (only stale 2026-06-04 docs present). Verified: cargo build warnings 2 <= baseline 10; cargo test -- --test-threads=1 green; cargo build --release green; release CLI --help/resolve/setup green; global mc --help green; live mc TUI launched and exited with q.

title: Mute 'command finished' notifications (zero-signal noise)
description: All notifications that just say a command/tool finished are pure noise — 0 signal to Boyan. Suppress them entirely. Keep only meaningful notifications (agent needs input, error/failure, blocked, done-with-result). Audit notification sources (cmux hook events Notification/Stop, agentLifecycle transitions, mc-emitted notifications) and drop the 'completed'/'command finished' class.
notes: AUDIT (2026-06-10): mission-control emits NO OS notifications — no osascript/terminal-notifier/notification call exists anywhere in src/. mc only READS mux_status.last_event (== 'notification' → AgentState::NeedsMe) for in-TUI state. The 'command finished' notifications come from the arcmux/cmux hook daemon (arcmux hook on Notification/Stop), NOT this repo. So haw cannot be implemented in mission-control as written — the suppression belongs in arcmux's hook→notification path. Recommend re-homing this ticket to arcmux.
close_reason: Misfiled — mission-control emits no OS notifications (audit confirmed: no osascript/terminal-notifier/notification call in src/). The 'command finished' notifications are fired by arcmux's hook->notify path (internal/manager/cmuxcli/notify.go). Re-homed to arcmux-wdk.

title: Scope typesafe to remote workspaces; drop dead file-based hook path
description: Only call classify_screen for remote (ssh/mosh) workspaces — local agents covered by hooks. Cuts ~300k API calls/day + 1.9GB llm.jsonl growth. Remove dead load_hook_status/status_dir file path (dir is empty, nothing writes it).
close_reason: Added SurfaceKind::Remote (foreground mosh/ssh ⇒ Remote, via from_comm/is_remote_comm). Workspace::is_remote() = any surface Remote. Gated typesafe classifier to remote-only in spawn_load_screen_preview + spawn_refresh_all_screens (local agents covered by hooks). Removed dead file-based load_hook_status + status_dir; hook_status now carried across refreshes via old_hook_statuses (was being wiped every tick by the empty status dir). Build clean; tests pass (cli_prompts failures are pre-existing parallel-race, pass single-threaded).

title: Make Beads updates appear live in Mission Control
description: Newly created Beads tasks are not appearing on the Mission Control page in real time. Investigate the refresh/caching path for Beads data and update the TUI so repo-local Beads changes show up promptly without needing a restart or unrelated window refresh. Acceptance: creating or closing a Beads issue in a visible repo updates the Mission Control Beads section within the expected live refresh interval, with focused regression coverage.
close_reason: Implemented Beads-only live refresh every 5s with stale-generation protection, avoided full/Beads refresh overlap, sorted same-bucket issues by updated_at, isolated tests from real HOME writes, and validated with tests/release build/review.

title: Separate info layer from command footer
description: The bottom info layer currently mixes window/workspace/surface IDs with command education/help text. Move the info layer to its own stable line one row above the command footer so IDs are always readable and footer shortcuts remain separate.
acceptance_criteria: Info layer (window/workspace/surface IDs) renders on its own dedicated line directly above the footer; footer shortcuts (Normal) and the :command bar (Command mode) render on the bottom line and never share a row with the info IDs; info line is full-width and left-aligned, truncated if needed; release build passes and both modes render correctly.
close_reason: Info layer now renders on its own dedicated full-width line (footer::render_info_line) directly above the footer; main.rs allocates 3 vertical rows (main / info / footer). render_footer and render_command_bar no longer embed or share a row with the info IDs. Release build passes.
